name: Gulf Power
note: Gulf Power Company (EIA utility ID 7801) merged into Florida Power & Light (FPL, EIA 6452) in 2021; its own EIA-861 filing was retired, so no separate federal service-territory boundary exists and it was missing from the map. Shown here as its historical Northwest-Florida service area — the eight counties Gulf Power served (Escambia, Santa Rosa, Okaloosa, Walton, Holmes, Washington, Bay, Jackson) — approximated from US Census county boundaries. This county envelope slightly overstates the footprint (~8,600 vs Gulf Power's ~7,550 sq mi filed area) because rural pockets inside those counties are served by cooperatives, not Gulf Power. Customer count is Gulf Power's pre-merger figure (~460,000).
